steps.title: Starting off
steps.text: Talk to the Raptor.
steps.warning: For the tracking to work properly, you need to have the chat visible, game messages set to 'On', and chat timestamps on.

steps.text: [Accept Quest]
Continue talking to the Raptor.
Continue with the portal in front of the Town Hall to enter.
Talk to the Herald of Varrock.

steps.title: Building the workroom
steps.text: Talk to Bill.
Start the Ranger's Workroom (Tier 1) blueprint.
Build the ranger's workroom in the south-west near the guardhouse.
Talk to Guard captain Sofía.
Talk to the Raptor.

steps.title: Retrieving the dragonkin device
steps.text: Open the gates to the north.
Click on the quest portal to the north.
Talk to the Raptor.
Search the spooky holes in the western room.
Kill the ghouls.
Construct the bridge.
Investigate the ancient door across the bridge.
Push either pillar.
Switch to the raptor.
Push the other pillar.
Search the ancient door.
Talk to the Raptor.
Go to the Varrock Library and continue with the portal by the entrance.

steps.title: Starting to dream
steps.text: Talk to Reldo.
Drink the potion.
Inspect the dragonkin device.

steps.title: Boulder puzzle 1
steps.text: Talk to the Raptor.
Stand on the pressure plate.
Swap to the Raptor.
Stand on the other pressure plate.

steps.title: Boulder puzzle 2
steps.text: Move the boulder to the marked tile.
Stand on the marked tile.
Swap back to the player character.
Stand on the marked tile.

steps.title: Boulder puzzle 3
steps.text: Swap back to the Raptor.
Move the boulder to the marked tile.
Push the boulder to the marked tile.
Move the other boulder to the marked tile.
Stand on the marked tile.
Swap back to the player character.
Stand on the marked tile.
Watch the cutscene.

steps.title: Boulder puzzle 4
steps.text: Swap to the player character.
steps.warning: Due to an issue in development, boulder puzzle 4, boulder puzzle 5, and The nightmare do not have tracking.

steps.text: Stand on the either of the tiles farthest away from the barrier.
Swap to the Raptor.
Push the boulder onto the pressure plate.
Swap to the player character.
Stand on the other pressure plate.
Swap to the Raptor.
Push the boulder onto the pressure plate.
Stand on one of the two remaining pressure plates.
Move the spawned boulder to the marked tile.
Swap back to the player character.
Stand on the remaining pressure plate.
Walk through.

steps.title: Boulder puzzle 5
steps.text: The Raptor steps on the western most pressure plate.
The player pulls the boulder and pushes it to the second pressure plate (going clockwise).

The player steps on the third pressure plate, and the second boulder appears.
  • If the second boulder does not spawn, exit to the lobby and continue again with the portal at the library.
The player pushes and pulls the boulder to the fourth pressure plate.
The player steps on the third pressure plate to open the gate.
Run to the strange girl to start a cutscene.

steps.title: The nightmare
steps.text: Go through all the chat options, then delve deeper into the dream.

actions.text: Why did you marry the king?
Couldn't you have been a warrior queen?
So you started wearing a disguise?
Is being rude to people an act too?

steps.text: Interact with the dim light.

Lower the health of the Nightmares as the player, then swap to the Raptor to deal the finishing blow.
  • Currently this part is glitched if you are in a group, which will prevent the player from progressing as expected. Simply leaving the group and re-entering the instance will allow progress.
Interact with the pillar of light and talk with the character that appears.
Continue on the path, and repeat the same process with the dim lights along the way.
Finally, speak to the Raptor that appears.
Read the ancient writings on the wall at the end of the path.
Finish talking to the Raptor.

steps.title: Back to the crypt
steps.text: Continue with the portal in front of the crypt in the Wilderness.
Watch the cutscene.
Enter the ancient door.
Investigate the map table in the central room.
Kill fetid zombies around the crypt and collect 10 map pieces.
Deposit onto the map table to start the puzzle.

Refer to the wiki to complete the puzzle.
  • Speaking to the Raptor to turn on accessibility mode is advised; this will highlight tiles while they are in the correct position.
Talk to the Raptor.

steps.title: Finishing up
steps.text: Talk to Overseer Siv in the Command Centre back at Fort Forinthry.
Talk to the Raptor.
